rdfs:label: Frequency
rdfs:comment: A rate at which something recurs — daily, weekly, monthly, etc.
notes: Used to type Frequency values referenced by `dcterms:accrualPeriodicity` (the frequency at which a dataset is updated). Common controlled-vocabulary values come from the EU Publications Office Frequency vocabulary. Values should be IRIs (e.g. EU frequency authority table); if only a string is available it is not a Frequency instance. For calendar recurrence rules use `urn:solid:rrule`.

history.note: Replaced non-existent schema:Frequency in seeAlso; removed claim that free-form strings are acceptable Frequency values; pointed to rrule for calendar recurrence.
